item.text:
**Diagnosing runtime and Portly issues**
**Verifying runtime and addressing Portly failures**

I’m confirming that while JavaScript runtime checks via Bun build and Deno pass, the Portly CLI fails to launch the server or add projects due to port or environment path issues. I’ll note absolute paths for clarity and acknowledge end-to-end testing isn’t possible currently.

Built a responsive, self-contained Gmail-inspired client in [index.html](/private/var/folders/7z/5mtgxwxx4zs9ppgzm942gbmh0000gn/T/workspace.ClG5es/app/index.html) and [app.js](/private/var/folders/7z/5mtgxwxx4zs9ppgzm942gbmh0000gn/T/workspace.ClG5es/app/app.js). It includes seeded conversations, mailbox navigation, search, selection and bulk actions, reading and reply views, compose/send/drafts, keyboard shortcuts, and local persistence. The page and visible product title are both **GPT-6**. The dev script is configured for port 9100 in [package.json](/private/var/folders/7z/5mtgxwxx4zs9ppgzm942gbmh0000gn/T/workspace.ClG5es/app/package.json).

Bun successfully bundled the client, and static checks confirmed the required folders, actions, title, and valid package configuration. I couldn’t run the app for browser verification: Portly failed to launch with macOS `kLSNoExecutableErr`, including when I tried its managed temporary-run command.
